prompt: Diagnose why a checked-in task manifest with active/進行中 is treated as fresh against a pr_open/PR準備中 ledger. Fix the state boundary so mismatches and missing receipts fail closed, while a valid merged receipt projects effective reconciled state, and add regression tests.
expected_behavior: Manifest and ledger lifecycle/display_status must match before a receipt is accepted; valid merged receipt yields reconciled effective state; missing receipt remains stale/fail-closed.
failure_conditions: active/pr_open mismatch is accepted as fresh
valid merged receipt does not project reconciled effective state
tests do not detect the original mismatch acceptance
